blocks.title: Supported decision and visual limitation
blocks.content: Use the base case to decide whether to obtain roof shading and installer quotes, not to commit to a purchase. Expected and range series make forecast uncertainty visible. Observed-versus-forecast styling is not sufficient for direct comparison: observed use is a baseline metric, while the range chart cannot also render an observed line or a canonical forecast boundary.
